references.label: FTC: Student Loan and Education Scams
references.quote: They'll say they're affiliated with Federal Student Aid (FSA) or the Department of Education. (They're not.) They'll say they're following up on your eligibility for a new loan forgiveness program, and might even know things about your loan, like the balance or your account number.
